body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature you can see within weapon range makes a ranged attack while adjacent to cover or an unattended object.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Make a weapon attack against the triggering creature, using its adjacent cover or object as the ricochet point. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and ignore 1 Defense granted by cover.

surges.html: Ignore 1 additional Defense granted by cover or increase this Reaction's range by 2 units.
On a success, reduce the target's equipment-granted Defense by 1 until its next turn.
